exposure: Rate of weight gain during the entire pregnancy
Weekly GWG in the second and third trimester
finding: High pre-pregnancy BMI, excessive GWG, and rapid first trimester weight gain are risk factors for cesarean delivery after induction (CDaI) in primiparous women.
mod_finding: High pre-pregnancy BMI, excessive gestational weight gain, and rapid first trimester weight gain were identified as risk factors for cesarean delivery after induction in primiparous women.
